business: Bramhollow Electric is a family electrical contractor in Bramhollow, a small town of older houses. Two electricians and an office manager work for homeowners: people fixing up an old house, adding an EV charger, or chasing a breaker that keeps tripping. The owner, Rosa Brandt, gave the four facts on the proof strip: she is a licensed master electrician, the company is insured for home electrical work, every job gets a written quote before work starts, and workmanship is guaranteed for one year. She also gave three reviews from customers who agreed to be quoted by first name and last initial, each rated 5 out of 5. Its phone, (555) 555-0171, its email, hello@bramhollow-electric.example.com, and the three figures in its stats row (founded in 1998, an average rating of 4.9, and 186 reviews) are set in Settings > Site Data, so the page binds them and no copy types them. Its service area there lists the towns its electricians go to, one per line.
